description:
Requires Java 11+ for java version, run "Start Starforge.bat" for Windows or "Start Starforge.sh" for Mac/Linux

A all in one continuation of Ontheheavens' Ship Editor. Since that editor is no longer being maintained, I asked Claude to build a updated version for my personal use and with features that Ontheheavens never had time to add before the project was abandoned.

Preview

Key features:

Key features:

Full mod loading: reads the base game and all your mods (or only the ones you choose), merging their files the way the game does.
Visual ship editing: weapon slots, launch bays, engines, bounds, ship and shield centres, collision and shield radius, with mirroring and snapping.
Variants and loadouts: fit weapons, hullmods, wings and built-ins, with a easy to use hullmod and weapon browser.
Skins and multi part ships: edit .skin files, and see modules attached to their parent (visible, faded or hidden); click a module to open it.
Built in resize: make a ship bigger or smaller in game, with every slot, engine and bound scaled to match.
Weapon editor: Stats, fire points, sprites and sounds, plus a firing preview for checking recoil, glow, animation frames and muzzle flash.
Automatic backups: every file is backed up before it's overwritten, and any save can be restored from Backups.
Companion mod: companion mod available for detailed hullmod values if you don't want to constantly tab between game and editor.

Comes in two versions, a Java version which runs on Java 11 or higher, or a browser only version for Chrome/Edge.

Source code available on Github

AI Use Disclaimer/Credits
Claude was used extensively for coding. The Engine flame textures come directly from OnTheHeaven's ship editor.
